verdict.rationale: AWS documents headless automation directly. The AWS CLI lets you control services from the command line and automate them through scripts, with console-equivalent functionality. IAM OIDC connects CI systems like GitHub Actions to AWS using temporary role credentials, and CloudFormation/CDK provision infrastructure from code. Missing for 10: explicit docs on non-interactive CLI behavior and output formats for CI pipelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: you can control multiple AWS services from the command line and automate them through scripts
OIDC connects applications, like GitHub Actions, that do not run on AWS to AWS resources.
when you assume a role, it provides you with temporary security credentials for your role session
CloudFormation takes care of provisioning and configuring those resources for you
